name: RunEvaluation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts. This parameter applies only to the multi-account check pattern
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID。该参数仅适用于多账号检测模式
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the governance maturity check. Valid values:

Account (default): Runs single-account governance maturity checks and checks only the current account.
ResourceDirectory: Runs multi-account governance maturity checks and checks all member accounts in the resource directory. Before performing this operation, upgrade to multi-account governance maturity checks
parameters.help_zh:
治理成熟度检测范围。取值：

Account（默认）：运行单账号治理成熟度检测，仅检测当前账号。
ResourceDirectory：运行多账号治理成熟度检测，即检测资源目录所有成员账号。操作前，需要先升级至多账号治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the check items to be checked
parameters.help_zh: 需要检测的检测项ID列表
parameters.name: metric_ids

parameters.help_en:
The check domain. Valid values:

CloudGovernance (default): Cloud governance maturity checks.
AiGovernance: AI governance maturity checks
parameters.help_zh:
检测领域。取值：

CloudGovernance（默认）：云治理成熟度检测
AiGovernance: AI 治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: evaluation_domain
